from tslearn.metrics.performance import mase
import numpy as np

y_train = X[0:2, :20, :]
y_true = X[0:2, 20:30, :]
y_pred = X[2:4, 20:30, :]
seasonal_period = 2

error = mase(y_true, y_pred, y_train, seasonal_period=seasonal_period)

mae_pred = np.mean(np.abs(y_true - y_pred), axis=(0, 1))
mae_train = np.mean(np.abs(y_train[:, seasonal_period:, :] - y_train[:, :-seasonal_period, :]), axis=(0, 1))
expected_error = np.mean(mae_pred / mae_train)

np.testing.assert_allclose(error, expected_error, rtol=1e-5)
print(f"__CHECK__ mase {error:.4f}")
